limitations: MATCH_OFFLINE means supplied evidence and candidate agree; it is not payment approval.
Network and unspent status are asserted by the supplied snapshot; no live chain or ownership proof is fetched.
Only a fixed 1000 sat/kB token-aware dust baseline is checked; actual node fee/relay policy, signatures, consensus and wallet behavior are not validated.
Only P2PKH, fungible tokens, final sequence, version 2 and zero locktime are supported. No NFT or minting.

capabilities: Single P2PKH BCH recipient or single fungible-token recipient.
Pinned official XO template resolves recipient script, BCH amount or fungible category/amount from request variables.
Independent planner supplies selected inputs, change and conservative fee budget.
Raw XO bytes are independently decoded by Guard and compared byte-for-byte to the plan.
limitations: Offline compilation diagnostic only; no accepted or authenticated Invitation, novel template, wallet or network operation.
All parent bytes, unspent observations, owner scripts and fee assumptions are caller-supplied offline claims, not authenticated evidence.
Request digest equality is content binding, not proof of human consent or spending authorization.
The engine count-only fee estimate is not used; independent actual fees and conservative signed-size policy govern the plan.
No keys, signatures, input discovery, reservations, signing, broadcast, receipts or live spendability checks.
